tagline: UDP par encrypted, multiplexed transport jo HTTP/3 ko power karta hai.
description: QUIC UDP par bana ek transport protocol hai. Yeh TCP aur TLS handshakes ko ek round trip mein jod deta hai, lagbhag har header bit ko encrypt karta hai, ek connection mein kai independent streams le jata hai, aur connection ko IP addresses ki jagah ek ID se pehchanta hai taaki network badalne par bhi woh chalta rahe.

normal.name: HTTP/3 par page load karo
normal.summary: Ek round trip encrypted QUIC connection set up karta hai, phir GET / stream 0 par jata hai.

steps.title: Client Initial
steps.detail: Browser ek long-header Initial packet bhejta hai. Uske CRYPTO frame mein normal TLS 1.3 ClientHello hota hai. Initial packets destination connection ID se nikali keys se encrypt hote hain, isliye koi bhi unhe decrypt kar sakta hai, lekin routers phir bhi bina pakde tamper nahi kar sakte. Padding datagram ko 1200 bytes banata hai taaki server kisi unverified address ko jitna mila usse teen guna se zyada kabhi wapas na bheje.

quiz.q: Client Initial ko 1200 bytes tak pad kyun kiya jata hai?
options: Amplification limit karne ke liye: address verify hone se pehle server jo receive kare uska sirf 3× bhej sakta hai
ClientHello ki length chhupane ke liye
quiz.why: Bada pehla packet server ko bada anti-amplification budget deta hai, jisse uska certificate fit ho jata hai, jabki spoofed chhote packets bade replies trigger nahi kar sakte.

steps.title: Server Initial + Handshake
steps.detail: Server apne Initial (ServerHello, plus ACK) se jawab deta hai aur usi UDP datagram mein, naye handshake keys se encrypted ek Handshake packet bhi. Kai QUIC packets ko ek datagram mein rakhna coalescing kehlata hai. Certificate fit nahi hota, isliye doosra datagram use CertificateVerify aur Finished ke saath poora karta hai. Dhyan do ki server ne apna connection ID khud chuna.

steps.title: Finish karo aur turant maango
steps.desc: Client Finished aur GET / ek saath
steps.detail: Client certificate check karta hai, Handshake packet mein apna Finished bhejta hai, aur usi pal 1-RTT packet mein HTTP/3 request bhi bhejta hai. Is packet ka header short hota hai: na version, na lengths, bas server ka connection ID aur ek protected packet number. Request stream 0 par ek HEADERS frame hai, jo client ki kholi hui pehli two-way stream hai.
facts: 1 round trip (TCP + TLS mein 2 lagte hain)

quiz.q: Laptop apna GET bhej sake, usse pehle kitne round trips lagte hain?
quiz.why: QUIC transport aur TLS 1.3 handshakes saath mein karta hai, isliye request ek round trip ke baad nikalti hai. TCP + TLS 1.3 mein do lagte hain.

steps.title: Response
steps.detail: Server HANDSHAKE_DONE frame se handshake confirm karta hai aur page stream 0 par wapas deta hai: ek HEADERS frame (status 200) phir ek DATA frame. STREAM frame par FIN bit stream 0 ko band karta hai. Pehle byte aur connection ID ke baad sab kuch encrypted hai, packet number bhi.

quiz.q: Is 1-RTT packet mein path ka router kya padh sakta hai?
options: Sirf pehla byte, connection ID aur UDP/IP headers
Sab kuch, QUIC plain text hai
quiz.why: Short header packets sirf flags byte aur destination CID dikhate hain. Frames, ACKs aur stream data samet, encrypted hain, aur packet number masked hota hai.

steps.title: Acknowledge
steps.detail: Laptop packet 0 ko ek chhote 1-RTT packet mein ACK frame se acknowledge karta hai. TCP se alag, QUIC byte offsets nahi, packet numbers acknowledge karta hai, aur kabhi packet number reuse nahi karta, isliye use hamesha pata rehta hai ki ACK original packet ka hai ya dobara bheje hue ka.

outro.title: Ek round trip mein HTTP/3
outro.text: QUIC ne TLS 1.3 handshake CRYPTO frames mein carry kiya, ek round trip ke baad short-header packets par switch kiya, aur request stream 0 par bheji. Wire par connection IDs ke alawa lagbhag kuch visible nahi hota, jisse middleboxes protocol ko jama nahi paate.

loss.name: Ek packet kho gaya, ek stream ruki
loss.summary: Do files do streams par load hoti hain. Ek ka packet kho jata hai; doosri chalti rehti hai.

steps.title: Do requests
steps.desc: style.css stream 4 par, photo.jpg stream 8 par
steps.detail: Connection pehle se khula hai. Browser do files ek saath maangta hai, har ek apni stream par: style.css ke liye stream 4 aur photo.jpg ke liye stream 8. Dono requests ek 1-RTT packet mein fit ho jati hain.

steps.title: Packet 5 kho gaya
steps.detail: Server packet 5 (style.css) aur packet 6 (photo.jpg ka pehla hissa) bhejta hai. Packet 5 internet par drop ho jata hai. Packet 6 pahunch jata hai, aur QUIC uske photo bytes turant browser ko de deta hai, kyunki stream 8 mein koi gap nahi. Sirf stream 4 ko wait karna padta hai.

quiz.q: TCP par HTTP/2 mein is situation mein photo bytes ka kya hota?
options: TCP unhe tab tak rokta jab tak kho gaye bytes dobara na aa jayein
Naye TCP connection par bheje jate
quiz.why: TCP ek ordered byte stream hai. Gap ke baad ke bytes buffer mein wait karte hain chahe woh kisi alag HTTP/2 stream ke ho: head-of-line blocking.

steps.title: Gap ke saath ACK
steps.detail: Laptop ek ACK frame bhejta hai: largest acknowledged 6, phir ek gap jo 5 ko skip karta hai. Jab server dekhta hai ki baad wala packet acknowledge ho gaya aur 5 abhi bhi missing hai (aur time guzar gaya hai), woh 5 ko lost declare kar deta hai.
facts: 3 baad ke packets acked, ya lagbhag 9/8 RTT guzar gaya

steps.title: Naye packet mein dobara bhejo
steps.detail: Server style.css bytes dobara bhejta hai. QUIC packets nahi, frames dobara bhejta hai, isliye data bilkul naye packet mein naye number ke saath jata hai. Kabhi confusion nahi hota ki ACK kaunsi copy ka hai, jisse round-trip measurements exact hote hain.

quiz.q: Dobara bheja gaya style.css data kaunse packet number mein jata hai?
options: Woh TCP sequence number reuse karta hai
quiz.why: QUIC packet numbers sirf badhte hain. Kho gaye frames agle naye packet mein daale jate hain.

outro.title: Head-of-line blocking nahi
outro.text: Kyunki QUIC ordering har stream ke hisaab se track karta hai, ek lost packet sirf us stream ko late karta hai jiska data usme tha. TCP par har HTTP/2 stream gap bharne tak ruki rehti.

migration.name: Wi-Fi se mobile data, same connection
migration.summary: Phone video ke beech mein Wi-Fi range se bahar nikalta hai. QUIC connection restart hue bina mobile data par chala jata hai.

steps.title: Wi-Fi par dekhna
steps.desc: Is baar server par capture hua
steps.detail: Yeh capture video server par liya gaya hai. Phone ke packets home router ke public address 198.51.100.7, port 40122 se aate hain. Server connection ko uske connection ID f067a5502a4262b5 se jaanta hai, us address se nahi.

steps.title: Mobile data par switch
steps.desc: Naya IP aur port, same connection
steps.detail: Phone Wi-Fi chhodta hai aur uska agla packet 4G par 198.51.100.200:61003 se nikalta hai. TCP connection mar jata: uski pehchan address/port ka pair hai. QUIC iske bajaye destination connection ID dekhta hai aur maujooda connection dhoondh leta hai. (Phones server ke pehle diye hue spare ID par bhi switch kar sakte hain, taaki dekhne wale dono paths ko link na kar sakein; idea wahi hai.)

quiz.q: Server ko naye address se aaye is packet ka purane connection se hona kaise pata chalta hai?
options: Nahi pata chalta; woh naya handshake shuru karta hai
quiz.why: QUIC packets ko connection ID se connections tak route karta hai, isliye address ya port badalna bas ek naya path hai.

steps.title: Naye path ko check karo
steps.detail: Naye address par bharosa karne se pehle server 8 random bytes ke saath PATH_CHALLENGE frame bhejta hai. Sirf wahi phone jo sach mein us address par hai use padh sakta hai aur bytes PATH_RESPONSE mein echo kar sakta hai. Tab tak server wahan kitna bhejta hai usse limit karta hai, taaki attacker traffic ko kisi victim par redirect na kar sake.

steps.title: Video chalta rehta hai
steps.desc: Data ab 4G par beh raha hai
steps.detail: Path confirm ho jata hai aur server agla video data naye address par bhejta hai. Pehle ki streams, encryption keys aur congestion state chalte rehte hain (sender naye path ke liye apna congestion estimate reset karta hai). Viewer ko, zyada se zyada, chhota sa pause dikhta hai.

outro.title: Connection migration
outro.text: Connection ko IP/port pair ki jagah ID se pehchanna QUIC ko network changes se bachne deta hai. Path validation yeh pakka karti hai ki naya address asli hai, uske baad hi us par zyada data bheja jata hai.

cheatsheet.title: Packet types
items: Long header, TLS ka baaki hissa
Server client se apna address prove karne ko kehta hai
